_note: Two fixes before the first publish of the Siddhant load. (1) CUB SalarySe Level Up: both Salary Day Bonus rows (37.5 SCoins per Rs.100 on the physical variant, 25 on the virtual-only variant) are paid only via SalarySe UPI on the 1st and last day of the month, but were filed as channel_specific/upi, so the engine paid them on every UPI payment at every merchant: CUB entered the top 3 on 231 of 273 merchants at 7.5%. They are now portal_bonus / channel portal / portal_name 'SalarySe app', which the engine and the SMS tracker never fire; name, rate, cap and sources are unchanged. CUB is back to 0.20% (top 3 on 0 merchants, as on prod 5.1.38). (2) HDFC Millennia: the issuer's 1,000-CashPoint cap is ONE pool across ten merchants per calendar month (Siddhant's document, and the issuer T&C quoted on the Amazon row). Nine of the ten rows had been renamed '5% cashback as CashPoints [merchant]', which gave ten separate Rs.1,000 caps. All ten share the name again, as they do on prod, with cap_period 'month' on all ten. validate_cards.py L5.CHANNEL_TEXT_VS_FIELD now exempts a portal_bonus row filed under channel 'portal', with a test; the exemption covers exactly these two rows today.
